eyebrow: Package it before you move it

steps.label: Flow alone
steps.sub: Stuck in the environment it was created in — no supported way to move it

steps.label: Flow inside a solution
steps.sub: Packaged with its connections and environment variables into one deployable unit

steps.label: Development
steps.sub: Build and iterate — breaking things here is cheap

steps.label: Test
steps.sub: Validate the solution against realistic data before anyone else touches it

steps.label: Production
steps.sub: Dispatchers run it for real, against real shipments

caption: A maker clicks Deploy; the pipeline exports, validates, and imports the solution into the next stage.

code:
Development:  Solution = UNMANAGED  (editable)

Production:   Solution = MANAGED    (locked)
caption: Locking Test and Production stops a quiet, unsynced edit to the live flow.
